source: Run T210 on Iced-Cream's own unit: an elkbench run of the scene-mutes plans under Iced-Cream's go, with one power cycle by Iced-Cream, and Iced-Cream's own listening check of its audio takes
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, build SMH1 (2026-11-08): with SCENE + FUNC + T1, T2 setting scene 1's mask, engaging scene 1 silenced BD and SD (-83 dBFS) while RS (-10) and CH (-11) played; CH muted by hand while engaged went silent; disengaging brought BD and SD back (-17, -14) and CH stayed muted. After a power cycle scene 1 still silenced BD and SD and the hand mute of CH was kept; <CLEAR> showed CLEARED and afterwards scene 1 muted nothing. Iced-Cream listened to the takes.
scope: scene-mutes 0.1.0-experimental alone on the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7, with analoghealth 1.3 as the remote-key harness.

builds.label: SMH1
builds.content: The Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant), this module from e5317b15, and analoghealth 1.3 as the remote-key harness (not under test). Driven over USB by elkbench in a ~T test project in slot 121; outputs recorded over USB audio; each flash passed the emulator gate first; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Scene 1 engaged: BD and SD silent (-83 dBFS), RS and CH played.
CH muted by hand while engaged: silent; kept after disengaging.
Disengaged: BD and SD back (-17, -14 dBFS).
After a power cycle the mask still muted BD and SD and the hand mute was kept.
CPU 74 % before the keys, 82 % at the end; heap flat; no freeze.

individualTestResults: Scene mask set with SCENE + FUNC + trig
Engaging the scene sets the mutes
Hand mute while engaged goes into the saved mutes
Mask kept through a power cycle

contextNote: Main OS hash not recorded; the .syx hash is the build's, not read back from the device. Not tested on a unit: <CLEAR ALL>, scene engage by CC 92, NRPN or Overbridge, kit changes.
